articles.title: 结石怎样形成
articles.body: 尿里的盐类过饱和时可能析出晶体。晶体可以黏在一起变成可见的结石。这是物理化学描述，不是诊断。实验室用成分化验对照标本，不等于给来访者下结论。
articles.bodyEn: Salts in urine can crystallize when the solution is supersaturated. Crystals may stick together into a visible stone. Physical chemistry, not a diagnosis. Labs compare composition with assays. That is a method, not a verdict about a visitor.

articles.title: 盐与尿钙的词条
articles.body: 高盐饮食在百科里常和尿钙升高一起出现。这是人群研究的摘要，不是禁盐令。预防段落仍把液体放在前面。不要把一张历史插图当成处方。
articles.bodyEn: High salt intake often appears beside higher urine calcium in encyclopedias. That is a population summary, not a salt ban. Prevention paragraphs still put fluid first. A historical plate is not a prescription.

articles.title: 草酸与植物食物
articles.body: 菠菜等植物草酸含量较高。词条讨论的是食物化学，不是禁止蔬菜。钙与草酸同餐的讨论属于营养百科。足量液体仍然重要。这不是诊断。
articles.bodyEn: Spinach and some plants are high in oxalate. Entries discuss food chemistry, not a vegetable ban. Eating calcium with oxalate is nutrition encyclopedia. Enough fluid still matters. This is not a diagnosis.

articles.title: 尿酸与嘌呤
articles.body: 尿酸来自嘌呤代谢。肉类和内脏在词条里作为嘌呤来源被提起。这是生物化学，不是点名谁必须素食。酸性尿有利于尿酸析出。这不是诊断。
articles.bodyEn: Uric acid comes from purine metabolism. Meat and offal appear as purine sources. Biochemistry, not an order that someone must go vegetarian. Acidic urine favors uric acid crystals. This is not a diagnosis.

articles.title: 感染与鸟粪石
articles.body: 能分解尿素的细菌会把局部环境变得偏碱，磷酸铵镁更容易析出。词条写微生物与晶体。发热加腰痛是急诊红旗。这不是给来访者命名感染。
articles.bodyEn: Urease-producing bacteria can make a local environment more alkaline, and struvite can precipitate. Entries write microbes and crystals. Fever with flank pain is an emergency red flag. This does not name an infection in a visitor.

articles.title: 体外冲击波碎石
articles.body: 体外冲击波用声波把结石打成砂粒。适应证和禁忌是专科讨论。百科只介绍原理和常见恢复：休息、补水、滤过尿液。这不是手术同意书。
articles.bodyEn: Shock waves break a stone into grit from outside the body. Indications and limits belong to specialists. Encyclopedias introduce the idea and common recovery: rest, fluids, straining urine. This is not a consent form.

articles.title: 肾脏的位置与结构
articles.body: 两枚肾脏贴在腹膜后面，内侧有肾门进出血管和输尿管。解剖图用来认结构。疼痛部位的百科描述不能代替检查。这不是诊断。
articles.bodyEn: Two kidneys sit behind the peritoneum. Vessels and the ureter meet at the hilum. Anatomy plates label structure. Encyclopedia pain maps do not replace an exam. This is not a diagnosis.

articles.title: 中医词条里的淋证
articles.body: 中医文献用淋证、砂石淋描述排尿不畅和砂石。这是历史与文化百科，不是把来访者写成某证型。现代急诊红旗仍然适用。不要把古方当成剂量说明书。
articles.bodyEn: Chinese medical texts use lin patterns and sand-stone lin for painful urination and grit. Historical encyclopedia, not a pattern assigned to a visitor. Modern emergency red flags still apply. Old formulas are not dose labels.

articles.title: 过饱和与抑制物
articles.body: 尿液里还有柠檬酸盐等抑制物，会干扰晶体生长。过饱和与抑制是一对平衡。这是溶液化学。化验报告属于诊所，不在这间休息室里开。
articles.bodyEn: Urine also holds inhibitors such as citrate that interfere with crystal growth. Supersaturation and inhibition are a pair. Solution chemistry. Lab reports belong in clinic, not in this lounge.

articles.title: 液体是预防的第一句
articles.titleEn: Fluid is the first prevention sentence
articles.body: 几乎所有结石预防词条都先写液体。目的是降低尿中盐类的浓度。这不是灌水比赛。呕吐到无法补水要立刻就医。这不是诊断。
articles.bodyEn: Almost every stone-prevention entry starts with fluid. The aim is a lower concentration of salts. This is not a water contest. Vomiting that blocks fluids means seek emergency care. This is not a diagnosis.

articles.title: 菠菜只是草酸例子
articles.titleEn: Spinach is only an oxalate example
articles.body: 菠菜反复出现，是因为它草酸高、又常见。词条没有说蔬菜有罪。烹饪和搭配会改变可吸收草酸。百科写食物，不开禁令。
articles.bodyEn: Spinach repeats because it is high in oxalate and common. Entries do not call vegetables guilty. Cooking and pairing change absorbable oxalate. Encyclopedias write food, not bans.

articles.title: 酸性尿与尿酸石
articles.body: 尿酸在较低 pH 时更难溶解。词条把 pH 写成数字，不是情绪。碱化尿液属于专科讨论，这里只解释化学。不要自行加大处方药。
articles.bodyEn: Uric acid dissolves less easily at lower pH. Entries write pH as a number, not a mood. Alkalinizing urine is specialist talk. Here it is chemistry. Do not raise a prescription dose on your own.

articles.title: 发热为什么是红旗
articles.titleEn: Why fever is a red flag
articles.body: 腰痛加上发热，百科常提示可能合并感染，需要紧急评估。这里只写就医时机。不要在聊天里给自己命名细菌。无法排尿同样紧急。
articles.bodyEn: Flank pain plus fever often signals that infection may be present and needs urgent assessment. This lounge only writes timing. Do not name a bacterium in chat. Inability to pass urine is equally urgent.

articles.title: 输尿管镜取石
articles.body: 输尿管镜从尿道进入，看到结石后再击碎或套出。术后支架很常见。恢复步骤仍是休息、补水、滤过尿液。这是器械介绍，不是预约单。
articles.bodyEn: A ureteroscope enters through the urethra, then fragments or baskets a stone. Stents are common afterward. Recovery steps remain rest, fluids, and straining urine. Device introduction, not an appointment slip.

articles.title: 肾单位与过滤
articles.body: 肾单位过滤血液，再调节水分和盐。结石发生在尿路这一侧。解剖课帮助理解部位词。它不能代替影像。这不是诊断。
articles.bodyEn: Nephrons filter blood and then adjust water and salt. Stones form on the urine side of that path. Anatomy class helps site words. It does not replace imaging. This is not a diagnosis.

articles.title: 砂石淋的历史插图
articles.body: 十八十九世纪的结石专著留下许多插图。用来看人们怎样谈论砂石。文化史不是把来访者写成砂石淋。现代红旗仍是发热、无尿、无法补水。
articles.bodyEn: Stone treatises from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries left many plates. They show how people talked about grit. Cultural history does not write sand-stone lin onto a visitor. Modern red flags remain fever, no urine, and blocked fluids.
